items.description: In the heart of Costa Rica’s vibrant capital, our San Jose hotel—fully renovated in 2023—blends a prime location with contemporary design crafted around each guest. From here, you are moments away from major corporate districts, the city’s celebrated dining scene, and cultural landmarks such as the Costa Rican Art Museum, the National Theater, and exclusive shopping areas. Just a short drive takes you to Poás Volcano National Park and the National Stadium of San Jose. With complimentary high-speed internet, proximity to Juan Santamaria International Airport, and a privileged setting across from La Sabana Metropolitan Park, the hotel offers versatile event venues, a fully equipped fitness center, and a serene outdoor pool. Every detail is designed to make your stay comfortable, productive, and truly memorable. The experience is elevated by distinctive dining: refined Japanese cuisine at Restaurante Fuji and reimagined Costa Rican flavors at Nattivo Urban Cuisine. Here, hospitality is felt in every gesture, and San Jose is yours to discover at its finest.

items.description: Discover the vibrant charm of Holiday Inn San José La Sabana, nestled in Costa Rica’s dynamic business and entertainment district. Our prime location places you a short drive from Juan Santamaria International Airport and near top attractions like the Museum of Contemporary Art & Design, the National Stadium, and Parque Viva. Embrace the lively culture of downtown San José, explore the historic National Theatre, and shop at the bustling Central Market, all just minutes from our doorstep. Immerse yourself in the best of Costa Rica with day trips to nearby beaches or adventures to Irazú Volcano National Park. Our hotel is perfect for blending business with leisure, offering modern meeting spaces and free parking to simplify your stay. With its blend of convenience and local charm, Holiday Inn San José La Sabana is your ideal starting point for a memorable visit. Enjoy an array of amenities designed for comfort and relaxation. Stay active in our 24-hour Fitness Center or take a refreshing dip in our outdoor pool. Relish meals at Gastro 118, featuring garden views and a cozy fire pit, and cap off your day with fun at our on-site casino. With complimentary Wi-Fi and plush bedding, unwind and rest easy after a day of exploration.

items.description: Welcome to our San Jose hotel in beautiful Costa Rica! When you stay with us, you’ll enjoy proximity to major attractions like Cataratas de la Paz, Hacienda La Chimba, and Volcán Poás. Touring the area or doing business in the capital city of San Jose is easy from our hotel. Plus, with over 20 restaurants serving delightful fare within walking distance, you’ll never go hungry. Breakfast is on us, though: our tasty buffet is complimentary for every guest. Load up with fresh fruit, Costa Rica-grown coffee, and pastries before heading out on your adventures. Take time to enjoy the pura vida in our newly updated pool and sun deck with resort-style lounge chairs or sip coffee on the terrace. When you’re ready for slumber, sink into your soft bed and enjoy a good night’s rest. We look forward to welcoming you to our San Jose, Costa Rica hotel!

items.description: Holiday Inn Express San José Costa Rica Airport is the perfect hotel choice in San José, Costa Rica, located just 1 mile from Juan Santamaría International Airport. Its proximity to the airport and easy access to the Carretera Interamericana highway make it a strategic location for business travel and tourism. From here, you can explore the vibrant city and the surrounding area with ease. Amongst the nearby cultural destinations are the Jade Museum, the Pre-Columbian Gold Museum and the emblematic National Theater. And what’s more, you can venture further afield and visit coffee plantations, the Monteverde Cloud Forest Biological Preserve or the Poás Volcano National Park. Our prime location lets you combine comfort with all the nature and culture Costa Rica has to offer. At Holiday Inn Express, your comfort is our priority. Start your day with a free breakfast, work out in our gym, and relax by the outdoor pool. We provide 24-hour transport to the airport, free Wi-Fi, and fully equipped rooms to make your stay a pleasant one. Hold your events and meetings with peace of mind. Our hotel is committed to providing every guest with an unforgettable experience.
